changelog_text:
- clutter slicing (trees and rocks)
- tree slicing has a tree ring texture applied
- tree slicing has fire vfx
- rock slicing has glowing vfx
- the furce rotation gained a shift modifier to rotate on a different axis
- added drop/undrop mechanic
- improved some performance
- improved the cut detection and slice plane (also added options to change algoritms for experimentation - the ones i think work the best are the current defaults)
